messages:
sophia: noticing an odd compactness hotspot in eu-west1-b this morning — compact pool CPU/GPU utilization diverging, small gpu pods stuck pending.
ben: saw that, pods in compact-pool-2 show Pending for >10m with taint:gpu-compact=small:NoSchedule
max: link to heatmap: https://grafana.redwood/ d/abcd/compactness?from=now-3h : the bins show one rack at 96% memory but gpu slots 0 available.
eli: can you paste kubectl describe of one pending pod?
sophia: ```kubectl describe pod training-tiny-43 -n experiments
Events:
  Type   Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----   ------            ----  ----               -------
  Normal Scheduled         12s   default-scheduler  Successfully assigned ...
  Warning FailedScheduling 10m   default-scheduler  0/50 nodes are available: 50 node(s) didn't match node selector.
``` 
ben: that's the selector for node.features.gpu_family=nvidia-a2 — but that AZ got a recent rack maintenance, NVLink nodes drained.
ops-bot: @channel autoscaler scaled up 6 nodes in eu-west1-b (reason: pending pods) :rocket:
max: autoscaler brought up g4dn-like instances which lack nvlink and our scheduler treats them as incompatible -> mismatch.
sophia: can we fall back to packing on compatible-but-weaker nodes instead of leaving jobs pending? eviction risk but avoids delays.
eli: propose a fallback policy: if pending > 5m, allow match on gpu_family=generic with cost-multiplier tag; also track QoS.
ben: worry: this will increase cost by ~12% for those runs, but reduce user-facing latency. we should gate by campaign/queue priority.
max: quick patch suggestion to scheduler predicates:
```yaml
- predicate: NodeGPUFamilyMatch
  params:
    fallback_after_seconds: 300
    allowed_fallbacks: ["generic"]
    cost_weight: 0.12
``` 
sophia: can someone do a canary for one pool? create policy for experiments namespace only.
eli: I'll roll it to compact-pool-2 as a canary in 15m and watch preemption + cost counters.
ben: set alerts: preemptions > 3/min or cost burn > $2/hr and we'll roll back.
ops-bot: deploy bot: rollout started for compact-scheduler-policy v2026.03.15-canary by eli
max: ack. Also add migration job to drain nodes that lost nvlink to avoid long-term fragmentation.
sophia: thanks team — will follow up with metrics and a short RCA once canary runs. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: ticket #INF-4923 created for follow-up (owner: ben).
